summary: Thin accessor: calls CustomMemoryPoolAllocatorInit() and returns the value at dword index 1 (byte offset 4) of the returned object. Called from many UI render and update paths, so it likely exposes a frequently-read field of a shared memory-pool or render-state object.

operations.description: Obtain the pool/object pointer via CustomMemoryPoolAllocatorInit().
Dereference dword index 1 (byte offset 4) of the returned object.
Return that field value as the function result.

unresolved: The field at dword index 1 of the memory-pool object has no identified meaning here.
Whether the returned value is a pointer, a count or a flag depends on the calling context.
